requirements.text: - BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline with industry experience.
- 2+ years of experience as a software engineer with proven contributions to team-based projects, ideally in an infrastructure, automation, or backend platform role.
- Solid programming skills, with deep proficiency in Python, Go, or C/C++ and a strong grasp of data structures and algorithms.
- Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, or backend automation workflows.
- Agentic Frameworks: Exposure to or strong interest in LLM orchestration, custom agent architectures, or API-driven automation.
- Infrastructure & SRE Familiarity: Basic understanding of Linux internals, telemetry pipelines (logging/metrics), and SRE concepts like MTTR and fault isolation.
- Distributed Systems: Knowledge of concurrent programming and distributed systems design.
